name: Wu Ying
current_role: Controlling shareholder (~49.6%) of Yangling Metron New Material (300.861.SZ); retired as chairman Nov 2024
profile: Wu Ying founded and chaired Yangling Metron New Material, a Shaanxi-based maker of electroplated diamond wire used to slice silicon wafers for the solar industry (clients include LONGi, Jinko, GCL). Listed on ChiNext in 2020. He stepped down as chairman in Nov 2024 on reaching retirement age, but remains controlling shareholder and actual controller.
interesting_fact: Metron's diamond wire - diamond micro-powder fixed on high-strength metal wire - is a key consumable for cutting solar-grade silicon wafers, tying his fortune directly to the PV boom.
deep_cut_fact: Early in his career he was director of the computer lab at the China Academy of Machinery Science and Technology Group.
notes: Resigned all company posts 18 Nov 2024 (retirement); Liu Haiying is now chairman. Company board-secretary office is the only published route. Resignation notice: https://pdf.dfcfw.com/pdf/H2_AN202411181640941995_1.pdf

name: Bindiben Binish Chudgar
current_role: Listed promoter/shareholder of Intas Pharmaceuticals (Ahmedabad); no public executive role found
profile: Bindi (Bindiben) Binish Chudgar is a member of the Chudgar family that controls Intas Pharmaceuticals, the Ahmedabad generics and biosimilars maker (Accord Healthcare in Europe/US) founded by Hasmukh Chudgar. She is named as a promoter in Intas's draft IPO prospectus and appeared on the Hurun India list in 2018-2019 via her stake. No public business profile found.
interesting_fact: Intas, through its Accord Healthcare arm, became one of the largest suppliers of generic medicines to the UK's NHS and a major biosimilars player.
notes: Very low public profile; relationship to Binish Chudgar (Vice Chairman/Joint MD of Intas) inferred from name only and not confirmed by a source. Best route is via Intas corporate / Binish Chudgar. Promoter listing: https://prod-mssip.morganstanley.com/content/dam/msdotcom/en/indiaofferdocuments/pdfs/Intas-Pharmaceuticals-Ltd-DRHP.pdf (per search snippet).

name: Zhou Weijian
current_role: Chairman and legal representative, Guangdong Maydos Building Materials Co. (美涂士), Foshan
profile: Zhou Weijian (周伟建; listed as 'Zhou Wweijian') chairs Maydos, a Shunde, Foshan-based paint and coatings maker founded in 1997 that sells decorative, art and stone-effect paints, adhesives and boards through ~12,000 franchise stores. UK-educated (master's), he also holds many civic posts, including Guangdong CPPCC member and vice chair of the Guangdong Paint Industry Association.
interesting_fact: Maydos says it has ~12,000 branded stores, 50,000 sales outlets and sells into 112 countries and regions.
deep_cut_fact: In 1999, two years after founding, Maydos won the tender to supply the full renovation of Beijing's Great Hall of the People for the PRC's 50th anniversary; in 1998 NPC vice-chair Wang Guangying visited and wrote the factory's name calligraphy.
notes: Name in input misspelled (Wwei-); correct Chinese is 周伟建 (not 周伟健). Private company, no IR channel; only route is corporate contact page. Also director of Meidi real-estate entities.

name: Liao Wenbing
current_role: Chairman, Shuangliang Eco-Energy Systems (600481.SH); executive at family-owned Shuangliang Group (Jiangyin)
profile: Miao Wenbin (缪文彬; romanised in input as 'Liao Wenbing'), b. 1978 in Jiangyin, is the son of Shuangliang founder Miao Shuangda. He joined the group in 2004, became VP in 2007 and chairman of listed Shuangliang Eco-Energy in 2017, steering it from absorption chillers/heat exchangers into polysilicon reduction furnaces, solar wafers and green-hydrogen electrolysers.
interesting_fact: Shuangliang says it has held over 65% of the market for polysilicon reduction furnaces for years, and is now selling green-power hydrogen electrolysis systems (e.g. a RMB450m order in 2025) - squarely in energy-transition hardware.
deep_cut_fact: Before joining the family business he studied information management at Nanjing University (BA 2000), later took a finance MBA from City University of Seattle, and started at Shuangliang in 2004 as assistant GM of the sales branch.
notes: Input name 'Liao Wenbing' is a misreading of 缪文彬 (Miao Wenbin); wealth shared with father Miao Shuangda. Highly relevant to energy podcast (polysilicon equipment, hydrogen, solar). Company had 2024 losses; avoid that topic. Also non-exec director of Shuangliang Sunrise (2481.HK). Confirmed chairman as of mid-2026 board notices.

name: Shao Jianxiong
current_role: Chairman and actual controller, Hoymiles Power Electronics (688032.SH); executive director & GM, Hangkai Holding Group
profile: Shao Jianxiong (邵建雄) chairs Hangzhou-based Hoymiles, a leading maker of solar microinverters, storage and balcony-solar systems, which listed on Shanghai's STAR Market in 2021. He controls it through Hangkai Holding Group, the Hangzhou industrial group he has run since the 2000s; Hoymiles' technology was co-founded by Zhejiang University power-electronics researchers Yang Bo and Zhao Yi.
interesting_fact: Hoymiles was built by pairing an established Hangzhou industrial group (Shao's Hangkai) with Zhejiang University power-electronics academics; CEO Yang Bo was a ZJU postdoc/researcher until 2017.
deep_cut_fact: Shao has been a director/chairman of Hangkai enterprise management since Aug 2002 and Hangkai Group's executive director and GM since Sept 2007; he took Hoymiles' chair in Sept 2017 after a few months as executive director.
notes: Not the technical founder (that is CEO Yang Bo / CTO Zhao Yi) - frame outreach around Hangkai/Hoymiles ownership. Strong solar/energy-storage fit for podcast. Route via board office (董秘办).

name: Lu Lin
current_role: Co-founder, director and core technical staff, Shanghai Friendess Electronic Technology (柏楚电子, 688188.SH)
profile: Lu Lin (卢琳) is one of five Shanghai Jiao Tong University-linked co-founders of Friendess (2007), which makes CNC control systems and software for fibre-laser cutting machines and dominates China's low/mid-power segment. Listed on the STAR Market in 2019, it posted 2025 revenue of ~RMB2.2bn. He is one of the five acting-in-concert controlling shareholders (~11%).
interesting_fact: Friendess says it holds ~70%+ of China's low/mid-power laser-cutting control-system market and ~40% of the high-power segment; the five founders reportedly took only living stipends at first and never raised outside capital.
deep_cut_fact: Lu is listed among Friendess's 'core technical personnel' - the engineers credited with the company's core control-system technology - alongside co-founders Dai Tiantian, Wan Zhang and Xie Miao, not just as an investor.
notes: Low public profile engineer-founder; chairman Tang Ye is the company's public face. Market-share figure is company-stated (via investor note/recruiting material). Route via board secretary office.
